name: Buffalo Chicken & Cauliflower Casserole
ingredients_verbatim: 1 large head cauliflower, broken into small bite-size florets
1/2 cup chopped green onions, divided (white and light green parts only)
2/3 cup cooked & chopped bacon, divided (about 6 thick slices or use pre-packaged real bacon pieces)
4 ounces block-style cream cheese, softened & cubed
3 cups shredded cheddar jack cheese, divided (2 cups, plus 1 cup for topping)
why: Verified 453 cal / 7g carb / 32g protein per serving on-page - dead center of the band. Oven bake (20 min at 375F), cheese-and-cream-bound cauliflower base with NO pasta/rice, weigh-and-divide scalable to 14. Distinct from the catalog's buffalo-chicken-pasta-bake (that is a high-carb pasta dish). Every ingredient maps to the board; rotisserie/shredded chicken can be rebuilt on chicken-breast for pricing.
